sequence.description: The log's head once the command committed: its last event, or the head it saw when it appended none.

changed.description: False for a command that was accepted and changed nothing, so appended no event.

sequence.description: The log's head when the command was rejected.

reason.description: Why the command was rejected, the code of its error: not_found when its target does not exist.

code.description: A stable error code in snake case.

error.description: The rejection as an error: its code (the reason), a message for people and structured data.

receipt.description: A command's receipt: accepted (with the head sequence after it and whether it changed anything) or rejected (with the reason and the error). A retry with the same commandId answers the same receipt.

result.description: The method's result, present when this request applied the command; absent on a retry and on a rejection.

unit.description: What an idle span is counted in: days, weeks (seven days) or months (calendar months, a month-end clamped to the shorter month's last day).

anyOf.description: A span of quiet: 1 to 1000 days, weeks or calendar months.

sessions.autoSettleAfterIdle.description: How long a session is quiet before auto-settle settles it (settledBy auto-idle); null never settles a session for being idle.

sessions.autoSettleOnMerge.description: Whether auto-settle settles a session one of whose pull requests merged at or after its anchor, the latest of its last activity, its unsettling and the end of its last snooze (settledBy auto-merge).

sessions.transcriptCompactAfterDays.description: How many whole days a session goes with no run, command or event before its transcript events are folded into a snapshot that replaces them for replay; 1 to 3650. Organisation events are never compacted.

values.description: Every setting's value, by key; a key never set holds its preset.
